title: Emergency Vehicle: Clear the Intersection, Then Pull Right
handbookSource: California Driver’s Handbook · Section 7 continued · Emergency Vehicles. https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/handbook/california-driver-handbook/laws-and-rules-of-the-road-cont1/ (checked 2026-10-15; final human review pending)
learnerPrompt: A siren sounds behind you. Where do you stop?

choices.label: Keep going to the next block

safeOutcome: You clear the intersection, pull to the right edge, and stop while the fire engine passes.
unsafeOutcome: Stopping inside blocked the fire engine’s path. Clear the intersection before pulling right.
